channel.title: Wearly Style Journal
channel.description: Practical outfit, wardrobe and packing guides from the Wearly team.

item.title: Business Casual Explained: What to Wear for Men and Women
item.description: What business casual means in 2026: clear do's and don'ts, outfit formulas for men and women, and how to adapt it for any season or office.

item.title: How to Build a Capsule Wardrobe: A Step-by-Step Guide with Checklist
item.description: Build a capsule wardrobe that works: how many pieces you need, choosing a colour palette, a full checklist, and 30+ outfits from 30 items.

item.title: Color Combinations for Clothes: The Outfit Color Matching Guide
item.description: Which colours go together in an outfit? Colour wheel rules, 15 combinations that always work, and what to wear with navy, olive and burgundy.

item.title: Cost Per Wear: How to Calculate It and Shop Smarter
item.description: What cost per wear means, the simple formula, real examples comparing cheap and quality clothes, and how to use it to buy less and waste less.

item.title: How to Organize Your Closet: A 7-Step Declutter and Organization Guide
item.description: Organise your closet in a weekend: a 7-step declutter method, what to keep, how to hang, fold and arrange clothes, and habits that keep it tidy.

item.title: What to Wear to a Job Interview: Outfits for Every Industry
item.description: What to wear to a job interview: how to read the dress code, outfit ideas for corporate, business casual, tech and video interviews, and what to avoid.

item.title: How to Pack Light for a 7-Day Trip (Carry-On Only Packing List)
item.description: Pack for a week in a carry-on: the 5-4-3-2-1 method, a complete 7-day packing list, how to choose a colour palette for travel, and folding and rolling tips.

item.title: How to Plan Outfits for the Week (A 15-Minute Sunday Routine)
item.description: Plan a week of outfits in 15 minutes: check the forecast and calendar, pick an anchor piece for each day, avoid repeats and prep the night before.

item.title: Wedding Guest Dress Codes Explained: What to Wear to Every Wedding
item.description: Black tie, cocktail, semi-formal, beach and casual: what each wedding dress code means, outfit ideas for men and women, and colours to avoid.

item.title: What to Wear by Temperature: A Complete Weather Outfit Guide
item.description: What to wear in 30, 50, 60, 70 or 80 degree weather: a clear °F and °C chart, plus how to dress for rain, wind and days that swing warm and cold.
